title: What the Vault Counted
description: The dead are back in their graves, but Father Osric is not at peace. The registers he keeps counting point at the sealed monolith in the deepest Vault — and since you cleared the crypt the seal has begun to sing. The cracks have widened. Go back down, approach the rift, and see what a hundred years too old is reaching toward. Whatever waits on the other side, it already knows you're coming.

objectives.desc: Descend to the Vault and touch the unquiet era-rift monolith
Get your bearings from the lookout in the arrival alley
